name: Houkago Ouji R ~Anata wa Dare to Kaeru?~
original_name: 放課後王子R～貴女は誰と帰る？～
source:
Hibiki Aikawa is an ordinary high school girl.
Suddenly, she was invited by Yukihiko Jinguji, the idol of her school, to go home with him...?!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6608]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
相川响是一名普通的女高中生。
突然，她被学校偶像神宫寺幸彦邀请一起回家……？！

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6608]NovelGame[/url]]
